facts.text: Faena New York is in West Chelsea, Manhattan.
facts.excerpt: Faena New York calls West Chelsea home, bringing signature style and visionary ethos to Manhattan.

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the High Line.
facts.excerpt: Steps from the High Line

facts.text: The hotel is located in the Chelsea Art Gallery District.
facts.excerpt: Chelsea Art Gallery District location

facts.text: The Meatpacking District and luxury shopping are nearby.
facts.excerpt: Meatpacking District and luxury shopping nearby

facts.text: Rooms and suites offer views of the Empire State Building and High Line Park.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in quintessential Faena flair and breathtaking views of the Empire State Building, High Line Park, and beyond.

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Rooms have Faena-designed interiors and abundant natural light.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by Faena-designed interiors and abundant natural light.

facts.text: Faena New York occupies the East Tower of One High Line.
facts.excerpt: Faena New York occupies the East Tower of One High Line

facts.text: One High Line is a work by Bjarke Ingels Group with a twisting geometric design.
facts.excerpt:
Bjarke Ingels Group
whose twisting geometric design catches sunlight like a prism

facts.text: The rooms and suites are designed by Alan Faena with the Faena Design Team and Peter Mikic Studios.
facts.excerpt: The 120 rooms and suites are designed by Alan Faena alongside the Faena Design Team and Peter Mikic Studios.

facts.text: Rooms feature animal-print motifs, sculptural lighting and marble bathtubs.
facts.excerpt: fabulous animal printed motifs, sculptural lighting, marble bathtubs

facts.text: Select suites have private terraces.
facts.excerpt: Select suites feature private terraces suspended above Chelsea’s architectural grid

facts.text: The two-story Faena Suite has a baby grand piano and a landscaped terrace.
facts.excerpt: the two-story Faena Suite, with three king bedrooms, a baby grand piano, and a landscaped terrace that sweeps from the Hudson to Midtown

facts.text: The lobby has a spiral staircase beside a large-scale mural by Argentine artist Diego Gravinese.
facts.excerpt:
A sand-toned spiral staircase arcs upward beside a large-scale mural by Argentine artist
Diego Gravinese

facts.text: Doormen in top hats greet arriving guests.
facts.excerpt: Doormen in top hats open the doors with the timing of a curtain rise.

facts.text: Tierra Santa Healing House spa occupies the entire underground level of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Set across the entire underground level of Faena New York, Tierra Santa Healing House is a 17,000-square-foot sanctuary dedicated to the art of living well.

facts.text: Tierra Santa Healing House is rooted in ancient South American healing traditions.
facts.excerpt: Rooted in ancient South American healing traditions and infused with a spirit of soulful transformation

facts.text: The Thermal Sanctuary includes a hammam, sauna, infrared sauna, steam room and restorative pools.
facts.excerpt: The Thermal Sanctuary includes access to a traditional hammam, sauna, infrared sauna, steam room, and restorative pools

facts.text: Hotel guests get complimentary access to the Thermal Sanctuary by reservation.
facts.excerpt: Guests of the hotel and non-hotel guests receiving spa treatments enjoy complimentary access to the Thermal Sanctuary by reservation.

facts.text: The spa has a dedicated couples treatment room.
facts.excerpt: A dedicated couples treatment room is available for deeper connection and presence.

facts.text: The fitness center is exclusively for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: The fitness center is exclusively for hotel guest use.

facts.text: La Boca by Francis Mallmann celebrates Argentine cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Celebrating the layered heritage of Argentine cuisine, La Boca by Francis Mallmann brings together bold tradition, soulful technique and a deep reverence for simplicity.

facts.text: The Living Room offers nightly live music and cocktails.
facts.excerpt: The Living Room offers nightly live music, seductive cocktails, and golden-age glamour

facts.text: The Living Room opens onto a terrace overlooking the High Line.
facts.excerpt: Two mirrored bars anchor a long gallery that opens onto a terrace overlooking the High Line.

facts.text: El Secreto is a hidden bar with handcrafted cocktails and live music.
facts.excerpt: Hidden and intimate, El Secreto offers handcrafted cocktails, live music

facts.text: The concierge works with local artists and curators on private gallery or museum tours, studio visits and neighborhood walks.
facts.excerpt: The concierge collaborates with local artists and curators to create tailored experiences like private gallery or museum tours, studio visits, and neighborhood walks

facts.text: Installations, performances and events turn the building into a living gallery.
facts.excerpt: with installations, performances, and events that turn its New York building into a living gallery

facts.text: The hotel offers twice-daily housekeeping.
facts.excerpt: Twice-daily housekeeping

facts.text: Room service runs around the clock.
facts.excerpt: Room service runs around the clock

facts.text: Guests can send requests via WhatsApp.
facts.excerpt: Guests can easily communicate any requests via WhatsApp

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs up to 25 lbs; the pet policy is limited to dogs.
facts.excerpt: Faena New York welcomes canine travelers up to 25 lbs. Kindly note that our pet policy is limited to dogs only.

facts.text: Photography, videography and audio recording are not permitted in La Boca, The Living Room and public spaces.
facts.excerpt: photography, videography, and audio recording are not permitted

facts.text: Each stay contributes a donation to Friends of the High Line.
facts.excerpt: each stay contributes a $10 donation to Friends of the High Line

facts.text: Bath amenities are plastic-free and refillable.
facts.excerpt: Bath amenities are plastic-free, refillable, and scented with the custom Futopia fragrance.

facts.text: The property plans a Faena Theater for live, cabaret-inspired performances in 2026.
facts.excerpt: In 2026, the property will expand with the creation of the Faena Theater for live, cabaret-inspired performances

facts.text: The Wall Street Journal called Tierra Santa New York's most extravagant spa.
facts.excerpt: New York’s most extravagant spa.
